entries.title: Joshua 11:1
segments: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor heard thereof, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,

entries.title: Joshua 11:2
segments: and to the kings that were on the north, in the hill-country, and in the Arabah south of Chinneroth, and in the lowland, and in the heights of Dor on the west,

entries.title: Joshua 11:3
segments: to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the hill-country, and the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpah.

entries.title: Joshua 11:4
segments: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea-shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.

entries.title: Joshua 11:5
segments: And all these kings met together; and they came and encamped together at the waters of Merom, to fight with Israel.

entries.title: Joshua 11:6
segments: And Jehovah said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them; for to-morrow at this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hock their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.

entries.title: Joshua 11:7
segments: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly, and fell upon them.

entries.title: Joshua 11:8
segments: And Jehovah delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they smote them, and chased them unto great Sidon, and unto Misrephoth-maim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.

entries.title: Joshua 11:9
segments: And Joshua did unto them as Jehovah bade him: he hocked their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.

entries.title: Joshua 11:10
segments: And Joshua turned back at that time, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.

entries.title: Joshua 11:11
segments: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them; there was none left that breathed: and he burnt Hazor with fire.

entries.title: Joshua 11:12
segments: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and he smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed them; as Moses the servant of Jehovah commanded.

entries.title: Joshua 11:13
segments: But as for the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.

entries.title: Joshua 11:14
segments: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any that breathed.

entries.title: Joshua 11:15
segments: As Jehovah commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua: and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that Jehovah commanded Moses.

entries.title: Joshua 11:16
segments: So Joshua took all that land, the hill-country, and all the South, and all the land of Goshen, and the lowland, and the Arabah, and the hill-country of Israel, and the lowland of the same;

entries.title: Joshua 11:17
segments: from mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and put them to death.

entries.title: Joshua 11:18
segments: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

entries.title: Joshua 11:19
segments: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: they took all in battle.

entries.title: Joshua 11:20
segments: For it was of Jehovah to harden their hearts, to come against Israel in battle, that he might utterly destroy them, that they might have no favor, but that he might destroy them, as Jehovah commanded Moses.

entries.title: Joshua 11:21
segments: And Joshua came at that time, and cut off the Anakim from the hill-country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the hill-country of Judah, and from all the hill-country of Israel: Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.

entries.title: Joshua 11:22
segments: There was none of the Anakim left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, did some remain.

entries.title: Joshua 11:23
segments: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that Jehovah spake unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land had rest from war.
